protocol.same_sampling: Each seed shares temporal splits, supervised batches, PDE collocation points, periodic boundary times, and initial-condition locations across models.
protocol.pca_scope: Full PCA basis fit on training-time snapshots only, then truncated at each k.
protocol.same_training_residual: JAX autodifferentiation of u_t + c*u_x for baseline and all PCA models.
protocol.periodicity: All models include a loss penalty on u(-1,t)-u(1,t).
protocol.evaluation: Same test-time indices and common grid-difference residual metric within each seed.
protocol.timing: Compilation is measured separately; each PCA pipeline includes training-only basis fitting.
